purpose: Route CI/CD lifecycle, cost, event-topology, required-check, and pipeline-migration work here, while keeping the three near-neighbours routing to themselves: cd-pipeline-generator (the deployment stages), cicd-integration (wiring a test suite and its quality gates), and shipping-and-launch (post-release production verification).

cases.prompt: optimize CI cost, our action minutes bill is out of control
make pipelines run only at the end of a plan instead of every phase
move CI logic into repository scripts so I can run the same checks locally
why does our CI pipeline run the whole suite twice for one change
our required status check is stuck pending and the branch will not merge
audit our GitHub Actions pipeline against a cost-aware contract
generate a blue-green deployment stage with rollback for our kubernetes cluster
set up dev to staging to production promotion with approval gates
wire our pytest suite and an 80 percent coverage gate into the pipeline
verify the production launch went well after we shipped the release
bump the version across every file, write the changelog, and tag it
cases.assert: routes to the /update release flow, not here
